accessions: GSE198652 (bulk RNA-seq, soleus + plantaris, old and young)
assay: bulk RNA-seq (Novogene, NovaSeq 6000), STAR in Partek Flow, DESeq2
primary_estimand: Effect of 8 wk progressive weighted wheel running (PoWeR) vs age-matched sedentary control on gene expression, within each muscle (soleus, plantaris) and age (old 22->24 mo; young 4-mo-start reference cohort from Englund et al.), each analyzed separately

age: 6 mo at GEO / 4 mo at start in paper (young)

inclusion: old: Control n=5, PoWeR n=4 for both soleus and plantaris (S2.8.p1); young: n=4/group (S2.8.p1, FIG7 legend); female mice (S2.2.p1, S3.6.p1 sex-matched)
planned_contrasts: Old soleus PoWeR vs Sedentary (S3.6.p1, FIG7 B/D, Supp Table 2)
Old plantaris PoWeR vs Sedentary (S3.6.p1, FIG7 F/H)
Young soleus PoWeR vs Sedentary (analyzed separately with same pipeline, S2.8.p1; FIG7 A/C)
Young plantaris PoWeR vs Sedentary (S2.8.p1; FIG7 E/G)
repeated_measure_unit: none (independent animals; soleus and plantaris come from the same mice but are analyzed per muscle)
normalization: DESeq2 median-ratio after excluding genes with max count <= 50 (S2.8.p1 'minimum read cutoff of 50 across all samples'; GEO data_processing)
paper_method: DESeq2 (Partek Flow), two-group per muscle per age, BH FDR
paper_results: DEG counts only in Supplemental Tables 2A-D (not available). Named genes: Aldh1l1 and Lrrn1 up in all four contrasts (FDR<0.05, S3.7.p1); old soleus up Agrn, Kat2a, Samd1, Zfp598 and down Ccnt(1), Gng5, Mylpf, Slc25a20 at FDR<0.10 (S3.8.p1); very few downregulated genes in old plantaris (S3.6.p1).
